name: Melilot
message: 「This is for me? I couldn't possibly accept something like this without a reason.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, that's right. Today is my birthday.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Eh. I am happy. Doesn't it look like it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm sorry. I'm just not very used to receiving things like this.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't look so worried. I truly am happy.」
